title: My love
author: Binay Laha
text:
When you smile I smile.
You have come to my life like a lucky girl.
You are my fulcrum.

You turned to be a love now.
You have given me big canvas.
I will paint my life.

We walk together.
We smile each other.
You are as mysterious as before.

It is better to love and die,than being alone.
